note: A bidirectional pad that drives its pin and also senses it. Used to fail, on hif-backend#89: the regenerated reader recomputed this design's own driver expression instead of reading the net, and was not even sensitive to the pin, so with another device driving it read zzzz. verilog2hif now keeps the continuous assign of an output or inout port that is read, and the reader reads the port. The testbench is that other device - without one, a design reading back what it drove gives the same answer either way. `bus` agreed on every row, which localised the defect to the reading half of the inout lowering; the driving half, from hif-backend#71, was correct. replicated_z_literal drives without reading back for exactly this reason, and this design is the read-back that omission left unasked.
